name: Ares’ Helm Minor Artifact
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 16th; Slot head; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This intricately crafted helmet enhances the wearer’s combat prowess. It grants its wearer a constant +1 (untyped) bonus to AC. Additionally, once per day, you can use a command word as a free action to enter a battle fury. While in a battle fury, the wearer rolls two dice on Strength-based attack rolls (using the better result) and deals an additional 1d6 damage with all melee weapon attacks. A battle fury lasts for 1 minute.

DESTRUCTION

First, the wearer of the helm must be involved in a battle that involves at least 1,000 troops or more, the battle must be lost by the wearer’s side, and the wearer must die in battle. Then, the blood of the losing commander and the blood of the dead individual that wore the helm into battle must be poured over the helm while the winning commander spits on it. As soon as the spittle and blood dry, the helm will shatter into thousands of pieces.

Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Ares, © 2023, Bloodstone Press; Author P. C. Graves and Beth Jones
